reviews.author: jagadeesh indlamuri
reviews.text: I recently visited Dr. Akshay jain skincare doctor and had a wonderful experience. He listened attentively to all of my concerns and gave me very helpful suggestions for protecting and resolve my issue. The doctor took plenty of time to understand my issues in detail and explained every step of the treatment plan clearly. The clinic was spotless and very welcoming, and the staff members were polite and respectful throughout my visit. I felt truly cared for and confident by the end of my appointment. I highly recommend Dr. Akshay Jain's SKIN LANE CLINIC to anyone seeking excellent care.

reviews.author: shabnum musaddiq
reviews.text:
Dr. Akshay Jain is a very wonderful and excellent dermatologist. I had been to him for my sister's sons consultation. He made the kid so comfortable. He is very knowledgable. He took his time to examine and explained the condition in detail. He prescribed the medications which resolved the condition completely. He is a very ethical doctor.
